cases.question: When does Nimbus notify customers about the end of a commitment and what is the consequence if they choose to renew at the end of the commitment period?
evidence_quotes: Nimbus will tell you 30 days before the end of the commitment, and you may choose a new commitment.
cases.reference_answer: Nimbus will notify you 30 days before the end of the commitment, and you may choose a new commitment.

cases.question: When should a billing dispute be raised to ensure a timely resolution according to the terms of service?
evidence_quotes: 20.4 A billing dispute must be raised within 30 days of the invoice date, through the Nimbus app or by contacting support.
cases.reference_answer: A billing dispute must be raised within 30 days of the invoice date.

cases.question: What is the minimum late payment fee and when does it apply?
expected_facts: third day after the due date
evidence_quotes: Late Payment and Suspension 6.1 If an invoice is not paid by the due date, Nimbus sends a reminder by SMS on the third day after the due date.
cases.reference_answer: The minimum late payment fee is Rs. 50 per invoice and it applies on the third day after the due date.

cases.question: What conditions qualify as a Force Majeure Event in the terms of service?
evidence_quotes: Force Majeure 27.1 A "Force Majeure Event" is an event beyond Nimbus's reasonable control, including flood, earthquake, cyclone, fire, epidemic, war, terrorism, a government order, a strike or the failure of a third-party power or telecom supplier, or a theft or cutting of cable by third parties.
cases.reference_answer: A Force Majeure Event includes flood, earthquake, and cyclone, among other events beyond Nimbus's reasonable control.

cases.question: What is the maximum number of times a customer can downgrade their plan within a six-month period?
expected_facts: no more than once in any period of 6 months
evidence_quotes: 16.3 You can downgrade no more than once in any period of 6 months.
cases.reference_answer: A customer can downgrade no more than once in any period of 6 months.

cases.question: What are the specific details Nimbus collects about customers according to the terms of service?
evidence_quotes: Privacy and Data Protection 22.1 Nimbus collects your name, contact details, address, identity and address proof numbers, payment information, plan details and usage data such as total data used and connection times.
cases.reference_answer: Nimbus collects your name, contact details, address, identity and address proof numbers, payment information, plan details and usage data such as total data used and connection times.

cases.question: When does a promotion code expire if used on a connection, and what is the maximum number of promotion codes that can be used simultaneously?
evidence_quotes: 25.2 Referral credits and promotion credits expire 12 months after they are granted.
cases.reference_answer: Promotion codes expire 12 months after they are granted and only one promotion code can be used on a connection at a time.

cases.question: What is the validity period for notices sent by post according to the terms of service?
evidence_quotes: A notice sent by post is treated as delivered 5 Business Days after posting.
cases.reference_answer: Notices sent by post are treated as delivered 5 Business Days after posting.

cases.question: When is a connection considered closed after a suspension for non-payment?
evidence_quotes: 19.2 Nimbus may terminate a connection for non-payment as set out in Section 6, after the connection has been suspended for 60 days.
cases.reference_answer: A connection is considered closed after a suspension for 60 days.
